item.title: A5 closed between Newtownstewart and Omagh - Highland Radio - Latest Donegal News and Sport
item.description: The A5 is closed this morning between Newtownstewart and Omagh due to a road traffic collision on the Beltany Road, with police saying they expect it to be closed for some time this morning. Diversions are in place via Drumquin and Baronscourt Road, and people are being asked to use alternative routes where possible.
